interpretation.plain_speak: Two targeted warning-triggered refreshes finally changed the outcome: under no-refresh pressure with cadence 2, 7 of 16 losses were prevented. The same rule did not prevent eventual loss in the other tested regimes, although it delayed failure substantially. Sham refresh never helped. This is a real corrective signal, but it is not robust enough to call a general rule yet.
interpretation.north_star_question: Demonstrates bounded native-warning-driven correction can work, while showing its present benefit is regime-sensitive.
interpretation.next_stage: replicate the frozen two-shot rule across a wider initial hand/state space without changing trigger, budget, policies, or thresholds
